scenarioDescriptions.Pip_Chat_Consent_Controls: Chat consent and separate allergy-sharing consent are enabled and visible.
scenarioDescriptions.Product_Label_Review_Stale: A prior package label declaration is clearly marked stale for the current product.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_Preview_Ready: The shopping preview shows exact required ingredient amounts before any confirmation.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_Unlinked_Manual_Items: Manual shopping items without an ingredient mapping remain visible and unchanged.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_Optional_Ingredients: The user-enabled optional recipe ingredient appears after the preview refreshes.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_Line_Exact_Quantity_Edited: The edited shopping amount remains the exact user-entered quantity.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_Duplicate_Consolidation_Opt_In: Duplicate ingredient lines are consolidated only after an explicit opt-in.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_Confirmation_Result: The server-confirmed shopping result is visible after explicit confirmation.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_List_Updated: The shopping list contains the confirmed exact ingredient changes.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_Preview_Dark_Mode: The shopping preview remains visible in dark appearance.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_Preview_Large_Text: Shopping servings and confirmation controls remain visible at accessibility text size.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_Preview_Revision_Details_Large_: Expanded shopping and pantry revisions remain readable at accessibility text size.
scenarioDescriptions.Product_Label_Saved_Keyboard_Dismissed: The saved label review confirmation is visible after the keyboard closes.
scenarioDescriptions.Product_Label_Review_Current: The recorded package label review appears as current for the product.
scenarioDescriptions.Recipe_Detail_Large_Text_Filipino: The long Filipino recipe title and safety status remain readable at accessibility text size.
scenarioDescriptions.Recipe_Detail_Large_Text_Safety_Filipino: The blocked recipe's deterministic allergen reason remains visible at accessibility text size.
